title: Flattening a binary matrix
statement: For a natural number $n$ and an $n\times n$ matrix $A$ over the field with two elements, flatten $A$ into a vector of length $n^2$ over that field by listing its entries in the order induced by the standard equivalence between pairs of indices and indices in $	ext{Fin}(n^2)$.
hypotheses_covered: An n by n matrix over the field with two elements
